xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3206: Synthesized review verdicts are not durably applied — verdict on disk, status pending for hours, agent never informed

plan.title: Synthesized review verdicts are not durably applied — verdict on disk, status pending for hours, agent never informed
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: A completed review verdict can sit fully synthesized on disk for hours while review_status stays pending, the work agent is never told, and the issue is flagged feedback_delivery_needs_you (PAN-3111 incident, 2026-07-27: verdict written 08:02Z, still pending at 10:26Z; operator hand-pasted the verdict). Three verified root causes: (1) both deacon verdict-recovery sweeps gate on reviewStatus === 'reviewing' (deacon-review-unsignaled.ts:161), so a written verdict with status pending has no reconciliation path despite ~15 reset-to-pending paths; (2) every deacon reader looks only for synthesis.md while self-review writes review.md, and the inline verdict parser rejects the prompt's documented vocabulary ('## Verdict: APPROVED' and 'CHANGES REQUESTED — <blocker>' per roles/review.md:158); (3) resolveIssueFeedbackTarget is tmux-name-bound and never consults the agents table, so a live work agent reachable via pan tell is declared unreachable and needs_you fires with zero delivery attempts.
narratives.Proposal: Six work items. WI-1: new shared module src/lib/cloister/review-verdict-report.ts with findVerdictReport() (synthesis.md preferred, review.md fallback) and parseVerdictReport() (APPROVED/PASSED/CHANGES REQUESTED — suffix/FAILED) plus unit tests. WI-2: new deacon sweep reconcileUnappliedReviewVerdicts() in deacon-review-unsignaled.ts, registered in runPatrol() after checkCompletedButUnsignaledReviews (deacon.ts:2855): for reviewStatus pending with reviewSpawnedAt set, find the latest run dir with a verdict report passing isSynthesisForActiveReviewRun, fail-closed guards (workspace HEAD must equal reviewed context.json headSha via async snapshotWorkspaceHeadsPromise; no newer reviewRequestedAt; 5-min settle), nudge-first if the review session is alive (30-min grace), else apply via setReviewStatusSync + deliverReviewVerdictFeedback for blocked + emitActivityEntrySync naming the sweep. WI-3: the three existing readers (checkCompletedButUnsignaledReviews, nudgeSynthesisForCompleteReviewerReports' synthesisAlreadyWritten, findLatestSynthesis) adopt the shared helper. WI-4: agents-table-backed live-session tier in resolveIssueFeedbackTarget (listOverdeckAgentStatesSync + tmux liveness, excluding review/test/inspect/ship/plan sessions) before the resurrection ladder, so needs_you requires a genuine miss. WI-5: regression tests for the sweep (incident shape, self-review blocked, stale HEAD, newer request, settle window, live-session nudge, no-spawn skip). WI-6: docs/REVIEW-AGENT-ARCHITECTURE.md gains a 'Verdict application and fallback sweeps' section; roles/review.md stale .overdeck/review/ paths corrected to .pan/review/.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the canonical signal path (pan admin specialists done review) or PR-comment mechanics
- Auto-applying verdicts when the workspace HEAD has moved (fail-closed by design; deacon-post-review-commits owns re-dispatch)
- Redesigning the ~15 reviewStatus: 'pending' reset paths — the sweep reconciles their aftermath
- Convoy/self-review mode selection, or reviewer prompt content beyond path corrections
- Backfilling historical stuck issues beyond what the first patrol naturally repairs
- Delivery transport tiers, dedup-key mechanics, or the suppression-loop counter

autoDecisions.summary: New dedicated sweep reconcileUnappliedReviewVerdicts() for 'pending' instead of widening the existing sweep's 'reviewing' gate
autoDecisions.rationale: The pending case needs stronger anti-stale guards (HEAD anchor, newer-request check) that would be wrong on the reviewing path; existing behavior stays untouched, and an old verdict can pass isSynthesisForActiveReviewRun when reviewSpawnedAt/lastVerifiedCommit are stale

autoDecisions.summary: Fail-closed on HEAD mismatch — never apply a verdict when the workspace HEAD differs from the reviewed headSha
autoDecisions.rationale: A moved HEAD means deacon-post-review-commits already queued re-review; applying the old verdict would lie about the current tree

autoDecisions.summary: Nudge-first when the review session is alive; direct apply only when dead or unhealed after a 30-minute grace
autoDecisions.rationale: The canonical CLI path (pan admin specialists done review) also posts the PR comment and does keyed feedback delivery; the sweep should prefer it whenever the agent can still act

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the needs_you misfire inside resolveIssueFeedbackTarget (agents-table tier) rather than at each surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou call site
autoDecisions.rationale: One fix covers review feedback, verification-runner, and strike-landing callers; call-site patches would leave the same miss in the other paths

autoDecisions.summary: One shared verdict-report module replaces the divergent inline parsers/finders
autoDecisions.rationale: The current parser rejects prompt-conformant syntheses (APPROVED, CHANGES REQUESTED — suffix) and ignores review.md; three readers had drifted independently

autoDecisions.summary: Also correct the stale .overdeck/review/ references in roles/review.md
autoDecisions.rationale: Runtime writes .pan/review/<runId>/ (PAN_DIRNAME); the stale references are a literal trap for agents that follow the role file over the spawn prompt's absolute path

items.title: Shared verdict-report module: findVerdictReport + parseVerdictReport with unit tests

expected_outputs: review-verdict-report.test.ts passes all parser and finder cases

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/review-verdict-report.ts exactly as specified in PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-3206.md): VERDICT_REPORT_FILENAMES = ['synthesis.md','review.md']; findVerdictReport(dirPath) returns {path, filename} for the first existing file; parseVerdictReport(content) matches /^##\s*Verdict:\s*(.+)$/im and maps APPROVED/PASSED→passed, CHANGES REQUESTED (optional —/–/:/- suffix captured as topBlocker, else ## Blocking Findings section title)→blocked, FAILED→failed, anything else→null. Add tests/unit/lib/cloister/review-verdict-report.test.ts covering every mapping, the blocker-suffix and Blocking-Findings fallback, garbage→null, and finder preference/fallback/null using a tmp dir.

items.title: parseVerdictReport maps APPROVED and PASSED to passed, CHANGES REQUESTED — <blocker> to blocked with that blocker, bare CHANGES REQUESTED plus a ## Blocking Findings section to blocked with the section title, FAILED to failed, and returns null for unrecognized content
findVerdictReport returns synthesis.md when both files exist, falls back to review.md when only it exists, and returns null for a dir with neither
npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/cloister/review-verdict-report.test.ts exits 0 and npm run typecheck completes without errors

expected_outputs: lint passes (file-size allowlist row added if the ratchet trips)

narrative.Action: Add reconcileUnappliedReviewVerdicts() to src/lib/cloister/deacon-review-unsignaled.ts per PRD WI-2 pseudo-code: iterate loadReviewStatuses(); gate reviewStatus === 'pending' AND reviewSpawnedAt set; resolve project + workspace like the sibling sweep (:163-166); find the latest agent-<issue>-review* run dir with findVerdictReport passing isSynthesisForActiveReviewRun; skip inside the 5-min settle window; skip when reviewRequestedAt postdates the verdict mtime; HEAD anchor — read context.json headSha and skip when async snapshotWorkspaceHeadsPromise(issueId, wsPath) returns a different sha (NO execSync — server code); parse via parseVerdictReport. Alive review session → nudge once with the same pan admin specialists done review command shape as :236-237 (pendingVerdictNudges map, 30-min dedup), apply directly only after a 30-min unhealed grace; dead session → apply directly. Apply = setReviewStatusSync(verdict, reviewNotes with 'applied by deacon sweep from on-disk <filename>' attribution, reviewedAtCommit for blocked when head known) + deliverReviewVerdictFeedback for blocked (runId: basename(latestDir)) + emitActivityEntrySync({source:'cloister', level:'warn', message naming the deacon sweep}). Wire up: re-export from deacon-review.ts; import in deacon.ts:36; call in runPatrol() immediately after checkCompletedButUnsignaledReviews() (:2855) with actions.push + addLog; add to the deacon.ts:1130-1145 re-export list. If scripts/lint-file-size.sh trips, add an audited scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row '<lines> <path> # PAN-3206' in the same commit.

items.title: Given a run dir with a settled verdict file, reviewStatus pending with reviewSpawnedAt set, HEAD matching context.json headSha, and a dead review session, one call to reconcileUnappliedReviewVerdicts() persists the verdict via setReviewStatusSync and emits an activity entry whose message names the deacon sweep
For a blocked verdict the sweep sends the parsed blocker and the run id to deliverReviewVerdictFeedback

The sweep produces no status write when the workspace HEAD differs from the reviewed headSha, when reviewRequestedAt postdates the verdict mtime, when the verdict is younger than 5 minutes, or when reviewSpawnedAt is unset

With a live review session the sweep nudges the agent with a pan admin specialists done review command instead of writing status directly, and applies directly only when a prior nudge is older than 30 minutes
The deacon-review.ts barrel export returns reconcileUnappliedReviewVerdicts, and runPatrol() in deacon.ts logs its action lines immediately after the checkCompletedButUnsignaledReviews call
Existing verdict readers adopt the shared helper (review.md + full vocabulary)

expected_outputs: existing synthesis and feedback tests still pass

narrative.Action: Create tests/unit/lib/cloister/deacon-review-unapplied-verdicts.test.ts per PRD WI-5, following the module-mocking pattern of tests/unit/lib/cloister/deacon-post-blocked-review-commits.test.ts: vi.mock review-status.js (loadReviewStatuses, setReviewStatusSync), projects.js, tmux.js, git-utils.js (snapshotWorkspaceHeadsPromise), review-verdict-feedback.js, activity-logger.js; build a tmp workspace with .pan/review/<runId>/{context.json, synthesis.md|review.md} fixtures. Cases: (1) incident shape — pending + spawned + APPROVED synthesis + dead session → setReviewStatusSync(passed) + activity event naming the sweep; (2) review.md CHANGES REQUESTED — blocker → blocked + deliverReviewVerdictFeedback with blocker and runId; (3) HEAD mismatch → no write; (4) reviewRequestedAt after verdict mtime → no write; (5) verdict younger than 5 min → no write; (6) live session → messageAgent nudge containing 'pan admin specialists done review', no direct write, direct write after 30-min grace; (7) reviewSpawnedAt unset → skipped. Use vi.useFakeTimers where nudge-age grace is exercised.
